neighbours.label: ' owing' in 'owing to' introducing a cause in formal technical prose
fire: Such steps are needed for the operation of the reactor, owing to the spacing of the various units and stores.
The sample size was small, owing to the rarity of the condition among adult patients.
Signal loss in the fibre is low, owing to the purity of the glass used in the core.
The yield fell sharply, owing to the drought that affected the northern provinces.
Imaging was difficult in this region, owing to the overlap of bone and soft tissue.
Costs remained high, owing to the distance between the mines and the processing plants.
Measurements were repeated, owing to the drift observed in the reference electrode.
The bridge was closed for months, owing to corrosion in the main steel cables.
